description:
## [1.2.0](https://github.com/tikkamasalla/stremio-morphe-patches/compare/v1.1.0...v1.2.0) (2026-10-19)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* a completed external playback saves its full position and is marked watched before the next episode opens ([db3b63d](https://github.com/tikkamasalla/stremio-morphe-patches/commit/db3b63d6ced8dbc8200ea2243a4d0239e918ee9a))
* address the external player directly, auto-pick only playable streams, safer binge and completion ([d47cbd6](https://github.com/tikkamasalla/stremio-morphe-patches/commit/d47cbd62d0a19c1cd63a91c2003156da49c50d22))
* an early opening or credits chapter is not counted as end credits ([6f70f89](https://github.com/tikkamasalla/stremio-morphe-patches/commit/6f70f8996841c635eaed838a1227877f94b65dfc))
* auto-pick does not re-pick after Back, track memory never overrides manual picks ([8f3afc2](https://github.com/tikkamasalla/stremio-morphe-patches/commit/8f3afc26249ae2b3b8be0035eee3e6e5b445c541))
* auto-pick only streams that match the title ([c2a9714](https://github.com/tikkamasalla/stremio-morphe-patches/commit/c2a97144c96d0d8d86e5d277ca026e324a2ff7ff))
* auto-pick prefers single-episode files and ranks packs and episodes over 25 GB last ([065838a](https://github.com/tikkamasalla/stremio-morphe-patches/commit/065838a3c80a84b53191f98922ae7d5bf6f57645))
* auto-pick rejects streams that name a different season or episode than the requested one ([c1d7e63](https://github.com/tikkamasalla/stremio-morphe-patches/commit/c1d7e63c6a54389657b1be2f900b3bc028683ab5))
* binge and auto-next only fire after a real completion, never on a quick error return ([d1da4cf](https://github.com/tikkamasalla/stremio-morphe-patches/commit/d1da4cfa72b6024b8b9fc21f12efd1fec4a99add))
* capture hand-off extras on every Vimu launch, retry subtitle carry-over, drop unnamed-chapter skips ([fceebce](https://github.com/tikkamasalla/stremio-morphe-patches/commit/fceebce18934ea9434297bf0f54ee9699b865cbd))
* ignore addon url ids when matching hearing-impaired tracks ([e8aeeae](https://github.com/tikkamasalla/stremio-morphe-patches/commit/e8aeeae3296b8765194df38daf6981bb1799296f))
* ignore IntroDB.app post_credits and make Vimu credits skip button-only ([7a184d8](https://github.com/tikkamasalla/stremio-morphe-patches/commit/7a184d8adbef2346fdba9ab0317eb06951c720bf))
* keep manual subtitle picks, English-only SDH handling, unique track ids ([2bde8ae](https://github.com/tikkamasalla/stremio-morphe-patches/commit/2bde8ae820954bc8ac3b48ac2b7ce7596b977c81))
* next episode pill saves the finished episode progress before navigating ([e86ecc8](https://github.com/tikkamasalla/stremio-morphe-patches/commit/e86ecc883e7216ff40d0685248def696a94fe37e))
* place the player hooks by instruction so intro skip runs, never wipe chapters on non-movie ids ([04214a2](https://github.com/tikkamasalla/stremio-morphe-patches/commit/04214a21f0e65cf226c06630ba338341236ae192))
* prefer text subtitle tracks over bitmap PGS/VobSub tracks in SDH ranking and track memory ([bb0b265](https://github.com/tikkamasalla/stremio-morphe-patches/commit/bb0b2655b00a7bfae0dcbf67415510ec25414989))
* resetMedia clears all per-media state and keeps the player-scoped exo caches ([01dee5f](https://github.com/tikkamasalla/stremio-morphe-patches/commit/01dee5f0048220ce7ce6a4c84e287fd37a8cefd4))
* second null dereference crash on rewinds in the Vimu media engine ([91e28e7](https://github.com/tikkamasalla/stremio-morphe-patches/commit/91e28e750a90ee386863abb020c6027524653782))
* settings switches show the stored value instead of the default ([e4a18ea](https://github.com/tikkamasalla/stremio-morphe-patches/commit/e4a18ea6e3927359505f79049daef1843575cbb5))
* strip trailing year ranges like (1999-) from titles before AniList and Cinemeta searches ([7e89598](https://github.com/tikkamasalla/stremio-morphe-patches/commit/7e895981e4c54a2e6f26df53e8e4551b46a99e7d))
* vimu hand-off extras are bound to the Intent they came from and re-read for a new one ([340825f](https://github.com/tikkamasalla/stremio-morphe-patches/commit/340825f26dc9910935e6e6b0c52ca083e5843348))
* vimu returns position on every exit ([81893f0](https://github.com/tikkamasalla/stremio-morphe-patches/commit/81893f0575473d5807d19a862b996f6f193ea377))
* vimu returns the result when the user leaves with Home, not only at stop ([678cd59](https://github.com/tikkamasalla/stremio-morphe-patches/commit/678cd597b81cbfce8d36f376d91c66a2ac49c14f))

### ✨ New Features

* add keyless IntroDB.app as fallback skip source per segment type ([1ace018](https://github.com/tikkamasalla/stremio-morphe-patches/commit/1ace01882dfda735229349a9575e832413ee8496))
* auto-pick best stream with stream ranker ([fcfc160](https://github.com/tikkamasalla/stremio-morphe-patches/commit/fcfc16036cd644a224ce201072db217e8cc8eeea))
* avoid SDH subtitles ([9c6928a](https://github.com/tikkamasalla/stremio-morphe-patches/commit/9c6928aacaa5be1a6218561e2f217548f9568ae6))
* binge next episode in external player ([3d093cc](https://github.com/tikkamasalla/stremio-morphe-patches/commit/3d093ccb4e86e3ac3e228185e25e3c629739b323))
* hide episode titles when spoiler mode is on ([35f35a6](https://github.com/tikkamasalla/stremio-morphe-patches/commit/35f35a61906617c92ec11e164c55a58d26216be4))
* log ranked streams and subtitle tracks for diagnostics ([3af2c16](https://github.com/tikkamasalla/stremio-morphe-patches/commit/3af2c1614fe6901af3dd86a7ebc57d1e19d1991d))
* long-press on an episode opens its stream list even with auto-pick on ([442045a](https://github.com/tikkamasalla/stremio-morphe-patches/commit/442045a24cb1b7d0501e01d7df084e29477d2dc2))
* pass media info and subtitle choice to external players ([a30839d](https://github.com/tikkamasalla/stremio-morphe-patches/commit/a30839d863f6cf9bdcc61085209b8056700cfe26))
* remember audio and subtitle tracks per show ([5b07edd](https://github.com/tikkamasalla/stremio-morphe-patches/commit/5b07eddf8d040f6db5a3b2d93d09d5232c4c2a5d))
* retry 429 and 5xx with backoff and cap lookups at 10s ([aadf7d4](https://github.com/tikkamasalla/stremio-morphe-patches/commit/aadf7d4c9ecbc44f5e41d80720085823b99a189a))
* retry TheIntroDB by tvdb_id then tmdb_id from cached Cinemeta meta ([d1b01d1](https://github.com/tikkamasalla/stremio-morphe-patches/commit/d1b01d16621c6d11ad538796a097fee5d54635c8))
* skip credits to end of credits with next episode pill ([f916dce](https://github.com/tikkamasalla/stremio-morphe-patches/commit/f916dce119c4f9548f2631bb917e526296fe0d9d))
* stronger SDH detection ([21de3fd](https://github.com/tikkamasalla/stremio-morphe-patches/commit/21de3fde92086be976a81867752ea0df6d6a446b))
